Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: a garden at night in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic white moonflower glowing softly with petals as wide as a stage, dozens of giant fireflies glowing warm yellow-green, giant dark leaves with silver edges, softly blurred bokeh lights far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall reclining on a giant moonflower petal with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by the glow of the fireflies and the soft moonflower light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous moonflower, fireflies and leaves around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
